{{Quote|Our union members might ordinarily use their vacation time to do their bit for freedom on Corellia and in the galaxy, but that's out because our union takes no position on the Galactic Civil War. So we pick berries instead.|[[Corellian Shipbuilders Union]] Local 44908|<ref name="SWG:LSFBP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Lair Suitable For Berry-Picking}} on Corellia</ref>}}
The '''hsuaberry''' was a fruit that grew in the wilderness of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:LSFBP" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a member of the [[Corellian Shipbuilders Union]] was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops on Corellia because he wandered too close to an Imperial outpost while picking hsuaberries. The worker took shelter in an animal den to lose the pursuit and successfully escaped. The Corellian Shipbuilders Union Local 44908 later realized that the den would make a nice base for berry-picking activities and recruited a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to drive out the animals.<ref name="SWG:LSFBP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hsuaberries were mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LSFBP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hsuaberries were mentioned in a mission called "Lair Suitable For Berry-Picking" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:LSFBP" />
